purpose: sarvasattvahitāya: donation of paṇas and purāṇas for worship and repair (saṃskārapūjārtham) involving a bhikṣuṇīsaṅgha
notes: Severely damaged fragmentary inscription. Only mentions the bhikṣuṇīsaṅgha (community of Buddhist nuns) as a collective institution; no individual human names are preserved.
